name: Gaia
summary: Precision astrometry mission whose stellar positions and motions trace the Galactic gravitational potential, stellar streams and dark-matter distribution. Data processing continues after observations end.
detection_principle: Continuous scanning measures stellar positions, parallaxes, proper motions and some spectroscopic velocities; dynamical models infer visible and invisible mass.
